Dig & Clean Items Database & Value Guide

Last updated: 2026-08-06 · Items catalog is not officially published. Known item families are confirmed by the game's Roblox description; individual names and values are community-reported or unverified.

Welcome to the most complete Dig & Clean item database we can build from public sources. Search by name, filter by rarity, or sort by value to find out what your latest discovery is worth. Each item includes a keep-or-sell recommendation based on community data.

How to Use This Database

  • Use the search bar to find any item by name.
  • Filter by rarity: Junk, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, or Legendary.
  • Sort by value to spot your biggest sellers.
  • Check the Recommendation column to decide: Keep for museum, or Sell for cash.

Keep or Sell? Quick Rules

  • Keep: Rare, Epic, and Legendary items with high museum value.
  • Sell: Junk and most Common items unless you are filling a display slot.
  • When in doubt: compare the sell value to the museum bonus.
